blocks.content: Now, let's write a program to implement an inline function.
Here, we created an inline function named display_num() that takes a single integer as a parameter.
We then called the function 3 times in the main() function with different arguments. Each time display_num() is called, the compiler copies the code of the function to that call location.

blocks.alt: In C++, the function body of an inline function is copied to the location of the function call.
